label: miso 169 online gated
definition: miso-169 ARM: miso_reserve_online_gated=true — THE SINGLE DELTA vs the same-recipe zero-delta control miso169_gated_A (PREREG-miso167 §2/§5, miso-168 corrected order). Reg+Spin split into an online-gated product (coupling row, measured CAMPD rho 0.1764 via data.online_reserve_rho — the RHO_CLIP 0.5 floor binds, the standing nyiso-144 owner escalation) and an ungated Supplemental product; nested measured Reg+Spin family priced on the published Schedule-28 $65/$98 two-step curve.
market_story: Reg+Spin are synchronised products in MISO: a resource must be on the grid (Reg additionally on AGC) to sell them, while Supplemental is the offline-quick-start product. The real market therefore prices synchronisation itself in tight hours - a unit that is not running cannot back Spin, so meeting the requirement in a scarce afternoon means holding synchronised iron online at its opportunity cost. This keeper gives the LP that structure: the gated Reg+Spin columns draw only on online output (coupling row, CAMPD-measured rho), Supplemental keeps its offline eligibility, and the measured cleared reg+spin MW clears against the published Schedule-28 $65/$98 curve. The price effect appears where and only where MISO own DA market priced scarcity - +$10.12 in the DA-foreseen scarce hours of 2025, $0.00 in RT-only hours - because a deterministic LP may claim exactly the foreseen half; the RT-only half of the summer gap is the disclosed model-class limit.
